help.stock: Name this stock and enter its supplier, received date, and stock expenses.
help.products: Record the product you received. You do not need to create or choose a SKU first; Tunakuza will reuse a matching SKU or create the needed SKU automatically when the stock is saved.
help.catalog: Record products first. Product families group related sellable configurations while Tunakuza manages SKU identity automatically.
help.record: Record the stock received. For individually tracked products, color and capacity can resolve into separate SKUs automatically when they represent different sellable configurations.
help.review: Check the stock information and all recorded product lines, then save a draft or receive the stock.
help.familyAssignment: Product family is the grouping identity. Related SKUs in the same family can have different configurations and Website prices while appearing as one storefront product.
help.autoSku: No SKU is required here. Continue with the product details and stock units; Tunakuza will reuse or create the correct SKU automatically when you save the receipt.
help.existingSku: Use this only when you intentionally want to add stock to one exact SKU that already exists.

validation.catalogRequired: Add at least one product to this stock.
validation.conversionPositive: Enter a conversion greater than zero.
validation.familyName: Enter the new product family name.

newProduct.title: Record a product without choosing a SKU

existingSku.title: Add stock to an existing SKU (optional)

history.title: Recorded stock
history.description: Current receipts remain available while the new recording flow uses direct product lines.
history.empty: No stock has been recorded yet.
